prod_incident.title: Caddyfile corruption after v1.3.43 blue-green deploy (2026-09-27)
prod_incident.symptom: public / returned 200 with empty body; /api/status fine; containers healthy
prod_incident.root_cause: deploy script used python re.sub fragment replacement corrupting Caddyfile (health block removed, 670B vs 1192B) -> reload broke / proxying
prod_incident.fix: rewrote full Caddyfile via heredoc (dual 3000+3002, health 3/2/2s, header_up, transport h1/h2); validate + reload
prod_incident.discipline: Caddyfile must be written whole-file heredoc; never fragment regex replace; verify non-empty <html after deploy
